name: approximate a norm by a weighted sum of the larger and smaller magnitudes
mechanism: take the absolute values of the two components, scale the larger by one constant and the smaller by another, and add; the constants are chosen so the worst-case relative error over all angles is minimised

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Alpha max plus beta min algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: an approximation of the square-root of the sum of two squares

fails_when: error of a few percent; not a substitute where the exact norm matters
instances: Alpha max plus beta min algorithm
